summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Nomura Holdings, a Japanese financial services firm, disclosing the disposal of treasury shares to settle Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and Performance Share Units (PSUs) granted as deferred compensation to directors, executive officers, and employees. No price per share, premium, or implied value is stated; shares are issued from treasury. The filing describes the allotment mechanics where allottees contribute monetary compensation claims in kind. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event. This is an ordinary equity compensation arrangement, not a special situation.
